legenda: Upbeat synthwave with chiptune elements, energetic and adventurous retro gaming mood, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese, 8-bit arpeggios, analog synth pads, pulsing bass synth, punchy gated drums, bright lead synth hooks, catchy anthemic chorus, polished modern production, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: O Arandu, plugin em que o modelo de linguagem propõe e o código do jogo Unity decide, cantado como synthwave com sons de videogame antigo.
descricao: Synthwave com chiptune sobre o Arandu, plugin de agentes de IA para Unity em que o modelo propõe e o jogo decide.
